Shows the mouse pointer again after [HidePointer](HidePointer).
@param canvas  BlitzPlus only: the canvas the pointer is shows. Optional, the pointer is shows for the whole window.
@gap BlitzPlus lets the pointer be shown per canvas; here the canvas is accepted and ignored, as there is only one window pointer.
